name: HugoNet
summary: Geelong ISP, formerly HC Internet (2005); defunct (WE MANAGE I.T. PTY. LTD., ACN 131 827 631).

events.details: Defunct. HugoNet's retail ISP site (on the https hostname after 2009) survived until 2013 and the domain showed Oracle Telecom by 2014, so death is adjusted to by 2014 - not 2008 (current) or 2009 (proposal). site rebranded to Oracle Telecom.

refs.label: 2013 capture: still a complete retail ISP (broadband/VoIP/dialup plans), not gone in 2008-09 as both current and proposal claim.
The June 2014 and July 2015 captures serve Oracle Telecom with no HugoNet branding; the http root already ran SSL/301 redirects from Oct 2013 (CDX).
ABR: WE MANAGE I.T. PTY. LTD. ACN 131 827 631
